Use the app. Go to hushh.ai, create your Private Agent One, and use it until you understand it: what it does, why it matters, and the value proposition — your information belongs to you, your agent works only for you, and nothing moves without your consent.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Software Engineer role based in New York, NY. The Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain end-to-end software solutions that power both the AI agent experience and the home "Puppy" device. Daily responsibilities include building and integrating front-end interfaces with back-end services, implementing secure APIs, optimizing performance, and ensuring a seamless user experience across web and device environments. The role involves collaborating closely with product, design, and AI engineering teams to translate privacy-first requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions. The engineer will also participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of the overall system architecture.
